# Space HR

> AI HR chatbot and employee self-service platform that automates payroll, performance management, people analytics, and HR operations.

Space HR is an AI-powered HRMS and ERP platform for mid-market and enterprise teams in the US, UAE, UK, Singapore, India, Canada, and Europe. It pairs an AI HR Concierge chatbot with payroll anomaly detection, predictive workforce analytics, 360-degree appraisals, leave and attendance tracking, and multi-country tax compliance. Every AI search on Space HR is answered with verifiable source attribution, grounded by VeritasGraph — an open-source GraphRAG knowledge-graph framework that returns each result with a citation and reasoning path.

## About
Space HR automates the employee lifecycle end-to-end: onboarding, attendance, leave, payroll processing with tax compliance, performance appraisals, goals and OKRs, learning, and people analytics. Its AI layer handles employee self-service queries 24/7, detects payroll anomalies before pay runs, predicts attrition and labor cost, and answers HR policy questions with cited, verifiable sources.

## Who Is It For
- HR professionals, HR admins, people ops teams
- CEOs, CFOs, and finance teams
- Companies with 50–5,000 employees
- Global teams across the US, UAE, UK, Singapore, India, Canada, and Europe
- Regulated industries: healthcare, retail, banking, manufacturing, construction, government

## Key Features
- AI HR Concierge chatbot — 24/7 employee self-service with source-attributed answers
- AI Payroll Auditor — anomaly detection and payroll error prevention
- Predictive workforce analytics — attrition prediction, labor cost forecasting
- 360-degree performance appraisals and OKR/goals
- Leave, attendance, and GPS check-in
- Multi-country payroll and tax compliance (US, UK, UAE, India, Singapore, Canada, EU)
- AI templates and approval workflow automation
